events.title: Spinful is part of the October Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey everyone,If you've found us through Next Fest, welcome.Over a year ago we had a simple idea, what if a slot machine was your weapon in a roguelite?A lot of work, late nights, and countless runs later, that idea became Spinful.One thing we wanted to be upfront about: everything in this game was made by us. events.title: Spinful Release Date and Demo Update. Achievements, Auto-spin and more!
events.summary: Spinful release date announcement!Spinful will release on Steam November 19th 2026. We are excited to announce the release date and all things are on track for a mid-November release. Hopefully there isn't anything else too exciting happening on that day. events.title: Spinful Demo Release
events.summary: I am extremely proud to announce that the Spinful Demo has just gone live this week as part of the Ukrainian Games Festival! This demo version has the following features:7 Pixel-Crafted Levels - each with their own retro themed soundtracks4 Weapon Types - up to 5 different rarities of each weapon to unlock and discoverCharacter Customization - unlockable cosmetics, pets and aura effects for your characterBonus Events, Crystal Jackpots and Huge Spins!The Spinful Demo will run for the foreseeable
